summary: File-attribute check with error handling (__cdecl; lpFileName, flag byte a2). Calls GetFileAttributesA; if it returns INVALID_FILE_ATTRIBUTES (-1), retrieves the last error via GetLastError, maps it through ErrorIDLookupTable, and returns -1. If the file is read-only (attribute bit 0 set) and the caller's reject flag bit is set (a2 & 2), stores error codes 13 and 5 through the two TLS getters and returns -1. Otherwise returns 0 (the file is acceptable).

operations.description: Call GetFileAttributesA(lpFileName) to retrieve the file's attribute flags.
If the attributes equal -1 (INVALID_FILE_ATTRIBUTES), the file was not found.
On the not-found path, capture the error with GetLastError and map it through ErrorIDLookupTable.
Return -1 on the not-found path after the error lookup.
If the read-only attribute bit (attr & 1) is set and the caller's reject flag bit is set (a2 & 2), reject the file.
On the read-only rejection path, store error code 13 through TLSOffsetGetter and error code 5 through TLSOffsetGetter_afd8.
Return -1 for the read-only rejection path, and 0 (success) otherwise.
Called by ConfigIniParser (0x00421CD0) and FileAttributeCheckSequence (0x005668F0) to validate a file before further processing.

unresolved: The meaning of error codes 13 and 5 (read-only rejection) is taken from the caller context in existing analysis; not confirmed by this packet.
The semantics of ErrorIDLookupTable's mapping and any side effects beyond the lookup are unknown.
The full meaning of the a2 flag bits beyond bit 1 (reject read-only) is not established.
